Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a report on workers' compensation premiums.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring the department of labor and industriesto report on setting workers' compensation premiums; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of labor and industries shallprepare a report on the use of total employer payroll as the basis forworkers' compensation premiums. The department shall compare the useof hours worked with the use of total employer payroll and discuss thepositive and negative aspects of each. In preparing this report, thedepartment shall also review how other states determine workers'compensation premiums. The report shall be delivered to theappropriate legislative committees by December 1, 2004.
